title: Add Phase 3 release finalization and archive workflow
summary: Add dry-run-first release finalization, released-packet history generation, archive workflow documentation, and safer manifest generation for unreleased or finalized release sources.
reason: Phase 3 gives the project a controlled path to finalize completed change packets into versioned release folders and archive generated release artifacts without adding runtime audit or media-processing behavior.
behavior_before: Change packets could generate indexes, changelogs, and manifests, but there was no safe finalization script, released-version archive workflow, or generated release history.
behavior_after: Release finalization can be previewed with a dry run, completed packets can be moved into versioned release folders when explicitly finalized, release artifacts can be archived, and release history can be regenerated from released packets.
manual_validation: Ran refresh_summaries.py for scripts/change_control paths successfully.
rollback_plan: Remove Phase 3 finalization scripts and archive/history docs. Keep Phase 1 and Phase 2 change packet, validation, changelog, and manifest generation.
notes: Phase 3 intentionally does not finalize or move current unreleased packets during implementation validation.
